issue.title: Recursively Delete Unreferenced Index Directories

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
* Add ability to list child "folders" in the blob store
   * Use it to implement recursive delete on all stale index folders when cleaning up instead of using the diff between two `RepositoryData` instances to cover aborted deletes and blocked primaries writing things after a snapshot has already failed
   * The safety of this operation is guaranteed by the fact that we get the list of to-delete indices before we write the new index-N blob, hence we can't accidentally delete any indices that might be created after the index-N has been written and will only run the cleanup if writing the index-N succeeds.
* Clean up on delete operations to keep the number of blobs to clean up in continuous operation low. In case of a clean repository the overhead of running the cleanup logic is completely negligible (it's only a few list calls on the indices path that's it and those are cheap since we can and do filter for first level children only in all three implementations).
* Add new infrastructure for running `*IT` style third party tests against real Azure, GCS and S3 repositories.
   * For S3 we also run the tests against Minio
   * I manually verified the 3rd party tests to work with real repositories and they don't require new infrastructure in Jenkins since they are triggered via the same env variables used by the REST style 3rd party tests already. The performance on GCS and S3 seems to be a non-issue due to bulk deletes, on Azure the situation is a little more dicey and since we don't have bulk delete and I'll try to speed up deletes there in another PR I'm working on now. 

* closes #13159

issue.title: Remove IndexShard dependency from Repository

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
In order to simplify repository testing especially for BlobStoreRepository
it's important to remove the dependency on IndexShard and reduce it to
Store and MapperService (in the snapshot case). This significantly reduces
the dependency footprint for Repository and allows unit-testing without starting
nodes or instantiate entire shard instances. This change deprecates the old
method signatures and adds a unit-test for FileRepository to show the advantage
of this change.
In addition, the unit-testing surfaced a bug where the internal file names that
are private to the repository were used in the recovery stats instead of the
target file names which makes it impossible to relate to the actual lucene files
in the recovery stats.

issue.title: Make Snapshot Logic Write Metadata after Segments

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
* Write metadata during snapshot finalization after segment files to prevent outdated metadata in case of dynamic mapping updates as explained in #41581
* Keep the old behavior of writing the metadata beforehand in the case of mixed version clusters for BwC reasons
   * Still overwrite the metadata in the end, so even a mixed version cluster is fixed by this change if a newer version master does the finalization
* Fixes #41581
